candidates.change_summary: Delete the line `pot = 0;` so pot is never reset after a win.
Delete the entire if-block so that pot accumulates forever and is never paid out or reset.

Replace 'uint random = uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.difficulty, msg.sender))) % 2;' with 'uint random = 0;' so that the bank always wins and the pot distribution behavior changes.

Replace 'uint random = uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.difficulty, msg.sender))) % 2;' with 'uint random = 1;' so the random branch never executes and pot never resets or pays out.
Replace 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(pot - FEE_AMOUNT);' with 'payable(bank).transfer(pot - FEE_AMOUNT);' so when a win occurs, the entire pot goes to the bank instead of the player.
Replace 'payable(bank).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT);' with 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT);' so the fee goes to the player instead of the bank when a win occurs.
Change 'pot = 0;' to 'pot = 1;' so the pot is not fully cleared after a win, altering subsequent payout calculations.
Delete 'pot = 0;' so the pot is never reset after a win, leaving the old balance to affect future payouts.
Delete 'payable(bank).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT);' so the bank fee is not paid on a win, changing the amount transferred to the player.
Replace 'pot += msg.value;' with 'pot += msg.value + 1;' so the pot accumulates an extra unit each play, altering the payout amount.
Replace 'require(msg.value == TICKET_AMOUNT);' with 'require(msg.value == 0);' so any call with zero value passes and adds nothing to pot, changing behavior when callers send zero.
Delete the entire 'if (random == 0)' block so that neither payout nor pot reset ever occurs, changing all subsequent behavior.
